bsr.name: BSR Manager App
safety: Dev has its own database: creating/editing/deleting test records is fine.
Never send email or SMS, never push to QuickBooks, never trigger payroll or invoice reminders — dev may still be wired to real Resend, Quo, and QuickBooks.

arc.name: Arc Studio
safety: Dev SHARES THE PRODUCTION DATABASE. Act only inside the test workspace; if the workspace switcher shows any other workspace as active, stop and mark the ticket blocked.
Never approve-and-launch, send, or publish anything outbound (campaign launch, external send, email, social post). Drafting and approving inside the test workspace is fine.
